title: Fluffy Dandelions
description: A whimsical micro-mod adding Fluffy Dandelions that can be plucked, placed, or “blown” to grant temporary Luck with charming particle and sound effects.
body:
**Fluffy Dandelions** is a cozy little mod that introduces a brand new flower into Minecraft: the **Fluffy Dandelion**.

It may look like a simple decorative plant at first, but it comes with a special interactive mechanic that brings a touch of magic and playfulness to your world.

✨ **Features**

- Naturally spawning flower that gently releases soft, drifting particles as it sits in the world.
- Spawns in **Forests, Flower Forests, and Plains**, blending seamlessly into natural biomes.
- Interactive blowing mechanic – hold the flower in your hand, crouch (Shift), and Right-Click to blow its fluffy seeds into the air.
- Stack usage – blowing consumes one dandelion from your hand, making the effect feel precious and rewarding.
- Luck effect bonus – blowing on the dandelion has a **25% chance** to grant you the Luck effect for a short duration, turning a simple moment of playfulness into a helpful advantage.
- Custom sound effect – enjoy a soft, cozy “blow” sound to match the action.
- Flower pot support – display it in a pot for an extra cozy decoration.
- Compostable – just like other plants in Minecraft.


![Blowing Fluffy Dandelion](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f016c3a736ffc446a3d2351d0d599292e50692e6.gif)

🌬️ **Why Fluffy Dandelions?**

Minecraft is full of big adventures, but sometimes it’s the little details that make a world feel alive. The Fluffy Dandelion is a small, cozy addition that blends naturally into the game while giving players a fun new way to interact with nature. Blow the seeds, hear the sound, feel the calm – and maybe even enjoy a bit of good fortune along the way.
